source.title: Mapzeroth 2.0.5 Modern travel data
source.toc_note: The tagged repository retains Mapzeroth Dev / 2.0.0-dev metadata. Data selection uses the pinned 2.0.5 release tag and Data/Modern only.
source.direction_rule: TravelGraph.lua:445-465. Expand a missing reverse for a portal without oneway. An explicitly authored reverse suppresses expansion.
source.label_note: label_en is a source comment, not an independently verified destination name.

Where the pad lands on the Ring (flight master floor)
